clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, you set out with moonwell water for Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar. The journey carries you from secluded training into the wider work of protecting Teldrassil.

After tasting the enchanted water of Shadowglen's moonwell, you meet Tenaron Stormgrip at the crown of Aldrassil. He seals the gathered water in a larger vessel and sends you beyond the sheltered glade. The road runs south toward Dolanaar, through woods where danger has grown harder to predict.

Dolanaar is the first major village beyond Shadowglen, along the cobblestone paths through central Teldrassil. Its own moonwell lies at the heart of the village. Corithras Moonrage, an elder who oversees preservation across the boughs, waits there. The vessel you bring places you in the wider effort to protect the World Tree.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.
Seek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.
Mind you stay on the road though, friend. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, adventurer. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do, and little time to do it in.
I think we'd best get started.
